name: APT29 day 1, Sigma rules (real lab recording)
description: Real Windows, Sysmon and PowerShell logs of MITRE's APT29 emulation, from OTRF Security Datasets (MIT licence). Alerts are public SigmaHQ rules matched on the real events; each keeps its rule's author and link (Detection Rule License 1.1). The day's real logons, process starts and connections stream through the Kafka topics. Attack or noise labels are ours, from the attacker's process trees, and are used only to score the ranking.
